title: Gowers norm at most one for sign-valued functions
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ be a Boolean-valued function on the hypercube, and let $g = (-1)^f$ be its $\pm 1$ lift, the real-valued function $g(x) = (-1)^{f(x)} \in \{\pm 1\}$. Then for every $k \in \bbn$, the $k$-th Gowers uniformity norm of $g$ (in power form) satisfies
\[
  \|g\|_{U^k}^{2^k}
  = \E_{x \in \{0,1\}^n}\,\E_{h_1,\ldots,h_k}\!\left[\mathrm{GP}(g, k, x, h_1,\ldots,h_k)\right]
  \;\le\; 1.
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a function from the hypercube {0,1}^n to {0,1}
g is the ±1 lift of f
replaced:
For every Boolean function $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ and every $k \ge 0$,
$\|(-1)^f\|_{U^k}^{2^k} \le 1$.
